title: U.S. Federal Debt Outstanding
description: Daily U.S. federal debt outstanding reported by the U.S. Treasury, preserving debt held by the public, intragovernmental holdings, and total public debt outstanding.

temporal.source_update_note: The source is updated each business day with data from the previous business day.

invariants: When both components are present: total_public_debt_outstanding = debt_held_by_public + intragovernmental_holdings, except exact documented source anomalies
debt_held_by_public and intragovernmental_holdings are null together or present together
component fields are required on and after 2005-03-31

known_source_limitations: The API returns the literal string null for debt_held_public_amt and intragov_hold_amt from 1993-04-01 through 2005-03-30; total public debt outstanding remains available.
The first observed record with both component amounts populated is 2005-03-31.

known_source_anomalies.description: The Treasury API total is $0.03 lower than debt held by the public plus intragovernmental holdings. Source values are preserved unchanged.
The Treasury API total is $10,000,000,000.00 lower than debt held by the public plus intragovernmental holdings. Source values are preserved unchanged.
